CREATE PROCEDURE [CFG].[HIST_STG_Order_Details] AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	DECLARE @StartDate datetime = GETDATE()
	DECLARE	
		@StartDateStr varchar(30) = CONVERT(varchar(30), @StartDate, 121),
		@CloseDate datetime = DATEADD(ms, -2, @StartDate),
		@Inserted int = 0, 
		@Deleted int = 0, 
		@Updated int = 0
	
	EXEC [LOG].[PACKAGE_RUN_LOG_ENTRY] 
		@PackageName = 'HIST_STG_Order_Details', 
		@TableName = '[STG].[Order Details]', 
		@StartTimeStr = @StartDateStr, 
		@Inserted = NULL, 
		@Updated = NULL, 
		@Deleted = NULL

	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM [IMP].[Order Details] GROUP BY [OrderID], [ProductID] HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Table [IMP].[Order Details] contains duplicated data and cannot be historized', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Order Details] WHERE [DAT_VON_HIST] >= @StartDate)
		DELETE FROM [STG].[Order Details] WHERE [DAT_VON_HIST] >= @StartDate

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Order Details] WHERE @StartDate BETWEEN [DAT_VON_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] <> '99991231')
		UPDATE [STG].[Order Details]
			SET [DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231'
		WHERE 
			@StartDate BETWEEN [DAT_VON_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] <> '99991231'

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Order Details] WHERE [DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [STG].[Order Details](
			[Discount],
			[OrderID],
			[ProductID],
			[Quantity],
			[UnitPrice],
			[DAT_VON_HIST],
			[DAT_BIS_HIST])
		SELECT 
			I.[Discount],
			I.[OrderID],
			I.[ProductID],
			I.[Quantity],
			I.[UnitPrice], 
			@StartDate, 
			'99991231'
		FROM 
			[IMP].[Order Details] I

		SET @Inserted = @Inserted + @@ROWCOUNT

		GOTO FINISH
	END

	CREATE TABLE #T 
	(
		[Discount] real,
		[OrderID] int,
		[ProductID] int,
		[Quantity] smallint,
		[UnitPrice] money,
		[SATZ_ID] bigint, 
		[DAT_VON_HIST] datetime,
		HIST_SCD_TYPE int,
		[DAT_BIS_HIST_PREV] datetime
	)

	INSERT INTO #T([Discount],
		[OrderID],
		[ProductID],
		[Quantity],
		[UnitPrice], 
		[SATZ_ID], 
		[DAT_VON_HIST], 
		HIST_SCD_TYPE, 
		[DAT_BIS_HIST_PREV])
	SELECT
		I.[Discount],
		I.[OrderID],
		I.[ProductID],
		I.[Quantity],
		I.[UnitPrice], 
		S.[SATZ_ID],
		S.[DAT_VON_HIST],
		2 HIST_SCD_TYPE,
		NULL
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			[Discount],
			[OrderID],
			[ProductID],
			[Quantity],
			[UnitPrice]
		FROM
			[IMP].[Order Details] I
		EXCEPT SELECT 
			[Discount],
			[OrderID],
			[ProductID],
			[Quantity],
			[UnitPrice]
		FROM
			[STG].[Order Details] S (NOLOCK)
		WHERE 
			[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231'
	) I
	LEFT JOIN [STG].[Order Details] S (NOLOCK) ON
		S.[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231' AND
		(S.[OrderID] = I.[OrderID]) AND
		(S.[ProductID] = I.[ProductID])

	UPDATE H
	SET [DAT_BIS_HIST] = @CloseDate
	FROM
		#T T
		INNER JOIN [STG].[Order Details] H ON
			H.[SATZ_ID] = T.[SATZ_ID]
	WHERE
		T.[SATZ_ID] IS NOT NULL AND
		T.HIST_SCD_TYPE = 2 AND
		T.[DAT_VON_HIST] < @StartDate

	SET @Updated = @Updated + @@ROWCOUNT

	INSERT INTO [STG].[Order Details]([Discount],
		[OrderID],
		[ProductID],
		[Quantity],
		[UnitPrice], [DAT_VON_HIST], [DAT_BIS_HIST])
	SELECT 
		[Discount],
		[OrderID],
		[ProductID],
		[Quantity],
		[UnitPrice], @StartDate, '99991231'
	FROM 
		#T T
	WHERE
		([SATZ_ID] IS NULL OR HIST_SCD_TYPE = 2)

	SET @Inserted = @Inserted + @@ROWCOUNT

	UPDATE S
	SET 
		[DAT_BIS_HIST] = @CloseDate
	FROM
		[STG].[Order Details] S
	WHERE
		[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231' AND
		[DAT_VON_HIST] < @StartDate AND
		NOT EXISTS 
		(
		SELECT 1 FROM
			[IMP].[Order Details] I (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
			(S.[OrderID] = I.[OrderID]) AND
		(S.[ProductID] = I.[ProductID])
		)

	SET @Deleted = @Deleted + @@ROWCOUNT
FINISH:

	UPDATE STATISTICS [STG].[Order Details]

	EXEC [LOG].[PACKAGE_RUN_LOG_ENTRY] 
		@PackageName = 'HIST_STG_Order_Details', 
		@TableName = '[STG].[Order Details]', 
		@StartTimeStr = @StartDateStr, 
		@Inserted = @Inserted, 
		@Updated = @Updated, 
		@Deleted = @Deleted
END
